This domain addresses the support of the ICT bid and tender process. It involves providing necessary information to owners regarding project suitability, performance expectations, and budgetary requirements, which accounts for 11.0 percent of the overall exam assessment.

editorial.overview: The Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD) credential is a globally recognized certification offered by BICSI. It validates professional knowledge in the creation, planning, integration, and project management of information and communications technology (ICT) distribution systems. The exam covers primary domains, including project scope, ICT solution design, bid processes, and installation support, ensuring professionals meet high industry standards for infrastructure design across various complex environments and technical project requirements.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the RCDD exam blueprint to understand the domains and their respective weights. Utilize official BICSI publications and training resources to study ICT design principles, codes, and standards. Candidates should focus on practical application, such as calculating pathway capacities and reviewing specifications. Ensure your BICSI profile contact information is current before applying for the exam to verify your eligibility status.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification is for ICT professionals with experience in design, management, or installation. Candidates must meet specific eligibility requirements, such as verifiable ICT design experience or other professional credentials as defined by BICSI.
